objective: Determine whether the trigger evokes the training character's observable traits without describing them in the prompt.

prompts.text: mivora, a 2D illustrated person walking through a library and stopping by a window.
mivora, a 2D illustrated person sitting on a bench beside a lake, then standing up.

predefined_rule: Judge each trait on each selected frame as present, absent, or unassessable; separately judge scene usability. Treat an unassessable frame as unknown rather than a miss. No automatic claim about real-person identity.
